penalties.text: LucidPro — funded payout: Minimum request $500. Maximum per request: Payout 1 $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 and Payouts 2+ $1,500 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $3,500 for 25K / 50K / 100K / 150K. The buffer (initial Max Loss Limit + $100) cannot be withdrawn. A request 'may be denied' if a trade before approval drops the balance into the buffer.

LucidPro, LucidFlex and LucidDirect — move to live: Receiving Payout 5 on a Flex, Pro or Direct plan puts the trader in a live review pool ('Payout 5 represents the maximum payout level'); transitions occur 'at the discretion of the Lucid risk team'. Accounts 'automatically move to Live' if no cash-out choice is made within 24 hours of the email. Live accounts start with a $0 balance, and all simulated prop accounts close when the trader moves live or takes the cash-out.…
Shared Dashboard Analytix terms: margin, leverage, position limits and risk controls may be changed on any account at any time without prior notice.
Lvlup — funded: Lvlup funded payouts are capped at 10% of the original starting balance per request: $2,500 (25K), $5,000 (50K), $10,000 (100K), $15,000 (150K), every 14 days.

Lvlup — funded: The funded account keeps a 5% EOD trailing drawdown based on the highest end-of-day balance, locking at the original starting balance once the account reaches 6% profit; 'A payout does not reset drawdown.'
Rewards are paid only under the Funded Trader Agreement, whose text is not published.

Prohibited Conduct includes 'any other type of behavior that the Company deems, in its sole and reasonable discretion, to be unlawful, unethical, deceptive, manipulative, high-risk, or otherwise posing an undue risk'; the Company has 'sole and absolute discretion in determining whether a violation has occurred', and corrective actions include 'withholding or forfeiture of funds, payouts, or rewards', without refund or compensation.
'Acting in a manner that may cause reputational or financial harm to the Company' is a violation that allows the same corrective actions, including withholding or forfeiture of payouts.
User Agreement can change 'from time to time without notice'; continued use binds users regardless of when they registered.
Payout and PRO rules are set out in a PRO contract sent after the Test is passed; the contract itself is not published.
Older FAQ says weekly PRO+ activity, current help says one traded day per calendar month (cohort to reconcile).

14.2.5: breach of the non-disparagement obligation (clause 16) is a ground for termination; clause 16 survives termination.

Terms may be modified 'in Our sole discretion', binding 'effective immediately upon posting'; Trading Rules and Prohibited Conduct 'subject to change at any time ... with or without notice'.

Failure "will result in the denial of any pending payouts, immediate cancellation of all associated accounts, and termination of the collaboration." Accounts bought since 14 Oct 2025: consistency score must stay at 15 % or below (rules page).

Prohibited conduct includes conduct that 'in the sole discretion of Topstep, represents uncommercial activity, is intended to game the market, is not a viable trading strategy, or is not responsible trading'; consequence can be forfeiture of withdrawals from every other account.
Trading Rules 'remain subject to change at any time and from time to time, with or without notice'; terms changes effective upon notice in a form at Topstep's discretion.

Express Funded Account — payout size: Each Express Funded Account payout is limited to "50% of your account balance up to the cap", with caps from $2,000 to $6,000 depending on account size and payout path. "Minimum Payout: $125." Live Funded Account payouts are not capped.

Topstep Express Funded Account — payout: Despite a nominal $50K–$150K buying-power label, the XFA starts at $0. MLL rises from a negative floor, locks at $0 and is set to $0 after first payout; on the optional Consistency payout path, best day ≤40% and at least 3 trading days.

The Funded Trader Agreement lets the Company 'modify, amend, or update the terms, conditions, plans, and payout requirements of this Agreement, and the rules published at the Help Center ... at its sole discretion and at any time', effective upon posting; Help Center rules are incorporated by reference.
Techniques "inconsistent with the spirit" of the programme may lead, at WeGetFunded's sole discretion, to cancellation of profits and refusal of any payment.

All programmes — funded (WGF) account: Each withdrawal is limited to 'up to 50% of their cumulative P&L, subject to a maximum amount'. Per-withdrawal maximums: Instant $850 / $1,500 / $3,000 (15k / 30k / 60k); 1 Step and 2 Step funded e.g. $1,800 / $2,000 / $2,250 on 50k and $3,000 / $3,500 / $4,000 on 200k for the 1st / 2nd / 3rd+ withdrawal.

All programmes — funded (WGF) account: Withdrawal requests are accepted only from the 16th to the last day of each month (UTC); none from the 1st to the 15th. A minimum of 7 calendar days from the cycle's first trade applies, and the cycle restarts after each approved withdrawal.
